independent_review.note: Executor evidence only; a separate reviewer must inspect the integrated source and run the registered selector before this card is accepted.

implementation: A competing createResearchCycle validates the current profile and bounded window, stores one coalesced pending window, and commits a frozen Error 409 with the active cycle identity. Replaying the idempotency key returns the same conflict.
The queued window survives a database restart and is consumed atomically by one later cycle. Earlier uncovered prefixes and later tails are both retained; the active cycle window is unchanged.

The independently recomputed cycle report records profile intent and scope, historical accepted monitor instruction/requirement/plan provenance, and deterministic next review conditions. A manual cycle states that it is finite and needs another explicit request.

After an accepted no-progress report, cancelling and retiring the old monitor and independently accepting a new Goal for the same Owner instruction and profile reuses the same NoProgressRecord and count.
known_limits: All source/network/native runtime cases in this receipt use sealed local fixtures. No live provider or long-running production monitor was exercised.
